basis.governing_question: How can Grupo Vale integrate the sales, purchasing and finance of the three regional food distributors it bought into its own?

sub_questions.question: Where do the three companies' sales, purchasing and finance differ from Grupo Vale's processes and systems?
What integration plan for the three companies can the board approve?
In what order should the three companies move onto Grupo Vale's processes and systems?
What gets the first company's sales, purchasing and finance running on Grupo Vale's processes and systems?

drivers.evidence: Grupo Vale has bought three regional food distributors
sales, purchasing and finance integrated into its own

work.unit: Unit diagnosed (interviews, process walk-throughs, workload and cost baseline)

phase_work.why: Three companies diagnosed two at a time, then the third; interviews sit inside each diagnosis. Within the archetype's 4-8 typical weeks.

work.unit: Unit-level design detailed with the unit's leaders

phase_work.why: Three designs two at a time, plan alongside; no whole-organization target model because Grupo Vale's own processes are the target, so below typical 6-10.

work.unit: Process area moved onto Grupo Vale's processes and systems and tested
First company live and stable on Grupo Vale's processes and systems

phase_work.why: Three process areas moved two at a time, then a live-and-stable period; archetype has no Implementation phase, so these pieces are estimated.

sizing.levers: Diagnose two companies in depth and extend to the third from data, and run all three process areas at once in Implementation.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Compare each acquired company's sales, purchasing and finance with Grupo Vale's processes and systems to find the gaps.

gate.label: Gap priorities
gate.decision: Which gaps in sales, purchasing and finance does the design take forward?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define how each company moves onto Grupo Vale's processes and systems and set the integration plan for the board.

gate.label: Go/no-go on cutover
gate.decision: Go or no-go on moving the first company onto Grupo Vale's processes and systems?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Move the first company's sales, purchasing and finance onto Grupo Vale's processes and systems and confirm they run.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the plan and first-company results for the 29 January 2027 board meeting?

architect_notes: Engagement length is open: phases are cut to the 12 weeks available, but the work adds up to 17-24 weeks.
Implementation runs before the board approves the plan on 29 January 2027; confirm whether the first company must be live before that meeting.
Departure from operating_model_redesign: Implementation added, since the type is assessment_and_implementation and the first company must run on Grupo Vale's systems.
Departure: whole-organization target model dropped from Design, as the brief makes Grupo Vale's own processes the target.
Implementation weeks are estimated, not taken from the library, and the brief does not say which company goes first.
